The '''Jengardin Millennial Warriors''' were a military order that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were the developers of the [[Jengardin double-bladed vibroblade]], and never waged war on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. In about [[700 BBY]], it merged with a number of other military orders, to form the [[Iotran Police Force]], a military force that was based on [[Iotra]]. Following the merger, the Warriors continued to exist within the Police Force, as an organizational unit.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'' spells the group's name as the '''Jengardin Millenial Warriors'''.
